title: Staged region switchover with heterogeneous variant hedging and cold-cache seeding
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: Implement a staged multi-region switchover workflow that (1) progressively shifts traffic across regions using tier-aware fences, (2) hedges model fallback risk by routing initial traffic to heterogeneous model variants, and (3) seeds cold KV caches with prioritized snapshots to reduce cold-start tail latency. This ticket covers orchestration logic, readiness gating, instrumentation, and an automated rollback window.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Orchestrator can execute a staged switchover across three regions: primary -> transit -> target with configurable stage durations and percent ramps. 2) For each stage, routing policy prefers same-tier capacity but will route up to a configurable percent of traffic to fallback model variants (heterogeneous hedging). 3) KV cache seeding runs before any stage traffic reaches >1% of target region capacity and exposes preflight metrics (prefetch_success_rate, snapshot_apply_latency, cache_warmth_percent). 4) Readiness gates evaluate: p95 latency delta <= 20% vs baseline, error rate <= 0.5%, cache_warmth_percent >= 35% or prefetch_success_rate >= 85%. 5) Canary stage with 1% traffic must be reversible within 30s and auto-rollback triggers if metrics cross thresholds. 6) End-to-end integration tests and chaos tests (network partition and degraded GPU) run in the lab environment and pass. 7) Playbook and Confluence runbook updated with step-by-step operator commands.
technical_notes: Design: New Switchover conductor service (stateless controller) will emit staged routing plans to Smart Router. Each plan includes: region sequence, per-stage traffic percent, tier constraints, fallback_variant_list (ordered), snapshot_id for KV seeding. Hedging: Smart Router forwards hedged requests to model variants using probabilistic sampling with deterministic hashing for sticky sessions. Cache seeding: snapshot replays use prioritized keys (high-frequency prefixes) and a prefetch queue capped by target GPU working memory. Readiness scoring: composite score = weighted(sum of normalized metrics) with weights configurable by project. Telemetry: Introduce 'switchover.*' metrics, per-variant latency histograms, and per-region cache_warmth_percent gauge.
runbook_snippets: Pre-switchover checks: circuit-health OK, model-variant compatibility matrix validated, backup snapshot exists. Execution: 1) stage0: dry-scan (0% traffic) to validate snapshot apply. 2) stage1: 1% target traffic with hedging 10% to fallback variants. 3) stage2: 10% target traffic, increase cache prefetch parallelism. 4) stageN: full ramp if all gates pass. Rollback: set routing to previous region and invalidate warmed keys from failed region to avoid stale KV inconsistencies. Postmortem steps recorded in confluence. Operator CLI: `rdw switchover start --plan-id <id> --dry-run|--execute`.
test_plan: Unit tests for controller plan generation and validation. Integration tests: simulate snapshot apply + prefetch and measure cache_warmth_percent. E2E lab: run staged switchover between us-east1, europe-west1, asia-south1 with injected 200ms cross-region latency and measure p99 tail behavior. Chaos: disconnect primary mid-stage and assert automatic rollback occurs and traffic returns to last stable region. Automation: nightly synthetic test runs as a Canary pipeline.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Hedging increases cost and could mask model regression. Mitigation: limit hedging to <10% traffic initially, enable detailed per-variant quality logs and automated quality regression alerts. Risk: Snapshot replays spike GPU memory/IO. Mitigation: prioritize keys and rate-limit prefetch; use backpressure metrics to throttle. Risk: Inconsistent KV state across regions. Mitigation: tag prefetched keys with switchover epoch and ensure read-path honors epoch mismatch until consistency achieved.
metrics_to_monitor: switchover.stage.duration_seconds, switchover.stage.composite_readiness_score, region.<region>.p95_latency_ms, region.<region>.error_rate, region.<region>.cache_warmth_percent, variant.<variant>.latency_p95, hedging.request_fraction, prefetch.snapshot_apply_latency_ms, rollback.trigger_count
dashboards_and_alerts: Dashboard: Switchover overview with stage timeline, readiness score, cache warmth heatmap, and per-variant quality panel. Alerts: readiness_score < 0.7 for 2m -> pager, rollback_count > 0 -> ticket auto-open. Latency spike guard: region.p95 > baseline*1.5 -> auto-scale and notify.
